hook_gate_existence_only.source: sibling research (frankensonos FIRMWARE_PATHS.md): the early boot script runs the hook only if the file exists, after the writable partition is mounted; static boot script from the 57.23 tree

hook_interpreted.source: sibling research: the boot script runs the hook through the shell, so no exec bit is needed; static boot script

hook_runs_synchronously.source: sibling research: the quoted boot-script line runs the hook in the foreground (no background operator); static boot script

jffs_noexec.source: sibling research: the writable partition is mounted noexec on these devices (kernel mount-exec hook); a statement from that lane, not re-measured here

watchdog_restarts_daemon.source: sibling research: live observations by that lane that a killed stock daemon is restarted by a watchdog within seconds; not re-verified here

hook_survives_update.source: sibling research: the hook path carries the preserve flag in the image's partition table of preserved files; static, 57.23 libraries
